exposure: time in hours from antenatal betamethasone administration to birth
cohort: Infants born at 22 0/7 to 27 6/7 weeks' gestation, excluding those exposed to multiple doses of antenatal betamethasone, those not receiving intensive care, and those with congenital anomalies.
finding: Even short duration of exposure to antenatal betamethasone was associated with improved neonatal survival and survival without severe neonatal morbidity among extremely preterm infants.
